recipe.visualDefinition: A complex, multi-layered typographic composition featuring a mix of hand-drawn script, outlined geometric sans-serif, and textured graphic elements including organic blobs, four-pointed stars, and a decorative lace border on a subtle halftone-textured off-white background.
coreVisualRelationships: Interlocking of solid script and hollow outlined letterforms
Contrast between sharp geometric stars and soft organic blobs
Juxtaposition of modern graphic shapes with vintage lace textures
Vertical stacking of distinct typographic styles creating a central focal point
coreInvariants: Off-white background with fine light-gray halftone dot texture
Deep maroon/burgundy as the primary typographic color
Use of a decorative lace-like horizontal element
Presence of a gradient-filled organic shape

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centrally weighted with a vertical orientation; large outlined letters form the structural base for smaller script elements.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, thin-outlined geometric letters in the center-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top script, flows down through the large outlined letters, and settles on the textured lace and bottom logo-like lockup.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample breathing room around the central cluster, emphasizing the collage nature of the elements.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Teal, Mustard Yellow, and Pink-to-Maroon Gradient (Graphic shapes)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-contrast dark text against a light background, with muted, mid-tone pastel accents.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Mix of expressive brush script and geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Script: High-contrast, vertical stress, brush-like terminals, and varying stroke widths.
Outlined Sans: Uniform thin stroke, geometric circular curves, and open counters.
Bottom Lockup: Bold, italicized script paired with a heavy, condensed sans-serif.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ascenders in script are elongated and slightly curved.
Outlined letters are oversized and serve as containers for other text.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between thin, hollow geometric forms and thick, solid organic script.

preserve: The layering of solid text over outlined text
The specific teal and mustard accent colors

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the expressive, vertical, hand-drawn feel of the primary text.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Geometric Sans like 'Futura' or 'ITC Avant Garde'
candidateDirections.reason: Provides the clean, circular geometry needed for the outlined elements.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create an off-white background with a very fine, light gray halftone dot pattern. Layer in a mustard yellow organic blob on the left, a teal four-pointed star on the right, and a pink-to-maroon gradient blob on the top right. Add a horizontal strip of intricate, vintage-style cream-colored lace across the lower third.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, thin-outlined geometric sans-serif letters in maroon in the center. Overlap these with a thick, expressive maroon brush script. At the bottom, place a logo lockup featuring a bold pink script above a heavy, condensed maroon sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Ensure the script text is legible despite overlapping the outlines.
Check that the lace texture has a realistic, slightly distressed appearance.
Verify the halftone background is subtle and doesn't distract from the foreground.
Confirm the color palette remains cohesive across all disparate elements.

adjustableVariables: Rotation angle of the script text

mustAchieve: A sense of depth through layering
Harmonious balance between geometric and organic forms

postGenerationChecks: Does the composition feel like a cohesive collage rather than random elements?
Is the maroon color consistent across different typographic styles?
Do the stars and blobs provide enough visual interest without cluttering?
Is the lace element integrated naturally into the stack?
recipe.reuseFormula: Layer [Expressive Script] over [Thin Outlined Geometric Sans] + [Organic Gradient Shapes] + [Vintage Lace Texture] + [Halftone Background].
